name: Theme manager
author: Brett
description: Roll colour, style and layout themes, or every themeable part at once. A tree of every token (built from the asset types, so new types show up by themselves) with tri-state ticks, locks, presets and search picks what a roll may change; rolls stay readable (contrast-checked palettes, sizes within the range the known themes use). Live preview, undo/redo, pin favourites, edit any value by hand, save a roll as standard asset@1 themes and manage them (apply, rename, duplicate, export, import, delete). Phone: drill-down tree. Nav → Plugins → Theme manager; Settings → Plugins → Themes.
